# Optum
> Provide healthcare services from primary care to specialty care, online pharmacies with more affordable prescriptions, and health benefit accounts to save on medical expenses.

## Products and services
- [Optum](https://www.optum.com/en/): All your health needs in one place, from finding a doctor and scheduling an appointment to signing up for a health benefits account and managing your prescriptions.
- [Optum Home Delivery Pharmacy](https://www.optum.com/en/pharmacy-services/medication-delivery.html): Get medications sent directly to your home with fast shipping and 24/7 access to our licensed pharmacists.
- [Optum Specialty Pharmacy](https://www.optum.com/en/pharmacy-services/specialty-pharmacy.html): For patients that require complex therapies, we offer personalized patient care, communication and resources for special conditions.
- [Optum Infusion Pharmacy](https://www.optum.com/en/pharmacy-services/infusion-pharmacy.html): For patients whose treatments cannot be taken orally or have to be given at a controlled pace, we offer both home infusions and infusion therapies at any of our many locations.
- [Optum Frontier Therapies](https://www.optum.com/en/pharmacy-services/rare-disease-therapies.html): We provide personalized support, simplified access to therapy and compassionate care for patients with rare conditions.
- [Optum Health Savings Accounts](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/health-savings-accounts.html): Optum Financial is a leader in HSAs, with tools that help you pay for medical expenses now and save for the future.
- [Optum Flexible Spending Accounts](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/flexible-spending-accounts.html): An Optum FSA allows you to set aside pretax funds to cover healthcare costs, using a payment card or paying out of pocket and requesting reimbursement online.
- [Optum Health Reimbursement Arrangements](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/health-reimbursement-arrangements.html): An HRA is an employer-funded account that helps you pay for eligible health expenses without using your own money.
- [Optum Lifestyle Spending Accounts](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/lifestyle-spending-accounts.html): Employer-funded assistance for lifestyle expenses including wellness, financial planning, childcare, groceries, adoptions and tuition reimbursement.
- [Optum Commuter Benefits](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/commuter-benefits.html): Members can save thousands of dollars with pretax funds for taking the train, bus, or commuter highway vehicle, or paying for a parking spot if their company offers these benefits.
- [Optum Care Locations](https://www.optum.com/en/care/locations.html): Find doctors and locations near you for primary care, urgent care and specialty care.
- [Optum Specialty Care and Services](https://www.optum.com/en/care/specialty-care.html): Explore the specialties and services we offer, and connect with your local Optum team to learn what's available in your area.

## Resources
- [Newsroom](https://www.optum.com/en/newsroom.html): Get the latest news and personal stories on changing healthcare for the better, from pharmacy and medications to health technology and value-based care.
- [Healthier You](https://www.optum.com/en/health-articles.html): Find tips and ideas to inspire healthy living at any age, on topics important to you and your family.
- [Patient Forms and Information](https://www.optum.com/en/patient-resources.html): Find patient forms and guides to download.
- [Care Resources and Education](https://www.optum.com/en/care/learn.html): From patient stories and condition guides to how-tos, find the information you need to prepare for visits, understand your options and take the next step in your care.
- [Pharmacy Resources and Education](https://www.optum.com/en/pharmacy-services/learn.html): Browse our resources of patient stories, tips and tools to support you with managing long-term medication and understanding the importance of self-care.
- [Financial Resources and Education](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/learn.html): Learn how to make the most of your health benefit accounts, prepare for future health care costs and build savings with these articles and guides.
- [Financial Tools and Calculators](https://www.optum.com/en/financial-services/planning-tools.html): Use our annual HSA contribution calculator, retirement health savings checkup tool, FSA savings calculator or commuter calculator to see how to save and pay for qualified expenses.

## Customer service
- [Customer Service](https://www.optum.com/en/customer-support.html): Whether you have patient questions, need to pay a bill or get more information about your health financial accounts, we can help.
- [Contact Us](https://www.optum.com/en/contact-us.html): Find a phone number, email address or contact form for your specific Optum service.

<script>
	/*LCP optimisation: fire page-track immediately during head parsing (not on DOMContentLoaded).
	  getText() returns '' because body elements don't exist yet — message and headLine DOM-fallbacks
	  are analytics-only fields; Adobe Target personalisation does not depend on them.
	  The empty-string trade-off is acceptable in exchange for starting the Alloy interact
	  request (edge.adobedc.net) as early as possible, removing it from the LCP critical path. */
	(function(){
	function getVal(id) {
		const el = document.getElementById(id);
		return el ? el.value : '';
	}
	function getText(selector) {
		const el = document.querySelector(selector);
		return el ? el.textContent.trim() : '';
	}

	let message = getText(".o5-detail-hero-banner__textAlignContainer span.o5-text__body-1");
	if(message === ""){
		message = getText(".o5-detail-hero-banner__textAlignContainer span.o5-text__body-1-opt");
	}
	if(message === ""){
		message = getText(".o5-homepage-hero__container span.o5-text__display-1");
	}
	let headLineVal = getVal('headLine');
	if(headLineVal === "" && getText(".o5-detail-hero-banner__main-heading_1").length > 0){
		headLineVal = getText(".o5-detail-hero-banner__main-heading_1");
	}
	else if(headLineVal === "" && getText(".o5-homepage-hero__bodycopy span.o5-text__display-1").length > 0){
		headLineVal = getText(".o5-homepage-hero__bodycopy span.o5-text__display-1");
	}
	const pagetitlevalue = document.title;

    window.adobeDataLayer = window.adobeDataLayer || [];

		let pagelanguage = "";
		if(getVal('pageLanguage') === "en"){
			pagelanguage = "english";
		}
		else if(getVal('pageLanguage') === "es") {
			pagelanguage = "spanish";
		}

		const origin = window.location.origin;
		const hostName = window.location.hostname;
		const allowedHosts = ['business.optum.com'];
		const href = window.location.href;

        let businessSite = false;
        if(hostName.includes(allowedHosts)){
            businessSite = true;
        }
		const targetWebsite = window.location.origin.split('.')[1];
		let thumbnailUrl = origin + getVal('imageURL');
		if(getVal('imageURL') === ""){
		    thumbnailUrl = "";
		}

        const referrer = window.location.referrer;
        let portalName = "";
        if(referrer != null && referrer !== "")
        {
        if(referrer.indexOf("myuhc") > 0  || referrer.indexOf("laww") >0
        || referrer.indexOf("optum") >0  || referrer.indexOf("uhg") >0
        || referrer.indexOf("uhc") >0 || referrer.indexOf("everettclinic") > 0
        || referrer.indexOf("polyclinic") > 0 || referrer.indexOf("care") > 0
        || referrer.indexOf("bank") > 0) {
            portalName =  referrer.replaceAll("http(s)?://|www\\.|/.*", "");
            }
        }

		let viewName = getVal('pageTitle');
		if((window.location.pathname === "/")){
			 viewName = document.title;
		}

		 if (window.location.hostname.includes('optumrx')) {
            adobeDataLayer.push({
            event: 'viewStart',
            target: {
                targetBusinessUnit: 'optum',
                count: 'true',
                targetLanguage: getVal('pageLanguage'),
                viewName:  viewName,
                targetPageName: viewName,
                targetWebsite: targetWebsite
                }
            });
		}
		//helix
        function isAllowedHost(hostname, allowedHosts) {
            return allowedHosts.some(function(allowed) {
                return hostname === allowed;
            });
        }
        const helixHosts = ['dev-helix.optum.com', 'stg-helix.optum.com', 'www.optum.ai'];
        if (isAllowedHost(window.location.hostname, helixHosts)) {
            adobeDataLayer.push({
            event: 'viewStart',
            target: {
                targetBusinessUnit: 'optum',
                count: 'true',
                targetLanguage: getVal('pageLanguage'),
                viewName:  'helix:home',
                targetPageName: 'helix:home',
                targetWebsite: window.location.hostname
                }
            });
		}
	const loggedInPage = getVal('loggedInPage') === 'yes';
	function getEligibilityHsid() {
		const el = document.querySelector('.o5-myoptum-eligibility [data-role="initial-payload"]');
		if (!el) {
			return '';
		}
		try {
			return JSON.parse(el.textContent).uuid || '';
		} catch (e) {
			return '';
		}
	}
	function buildTrackUser() {
		if (!loggedInPage) {
			return {
				loginStatus: "not logged in",
				userType: "",
				groupId: "",
				carrierId: "",
				hsid: "",
				rallyId: "",
				patientId: "",
				payerGroup: "",
				memberId: ""
			};
		}
		return {
			hsid: getEligibilityHsid(),
			groupId: "",
			rallyId: "",
			userType: "member",
			accountId: "",
			carrierId: "",
			payerGroup: "",
			loginStatus: "logged in",
			enterpriseId: "",
			customAttributes: {}
		};
	}
	function pushPageTrack() {
	if(href.indexOf("/forms/medicare-prescription-payment-plan") == -1 && href.indexOf("/forms/medicare-prescription-payment-plan/sample-payment-calculation") == -1) {
    adobeDataLayer.push(
        {
            event: 'page track',
            page: {
				experienceType: ( /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent) ) ? "mobile" : "desktop",
                is404: getVal('errorStr'),
				lang: pagelanguage,
                name: getVal('pageName'),
				group: getVal('pageTemplate'),
                sitesection1: loggedInPage ? 'secure' : 'public',
				sitesection2: getVal('siteSection2') ? getVal('siteSection2') : '',
				sitesection3: getVal('siteSection3') ? getVal('siteSection3') : '',
				sitesection4: getVal('siteSection4') ? getVal('siteSection4') : '',
	            test: "",
				referringSite: portalName,
                customAttributes: (function() {
                  const image = getVal('imageURL');
                  let headLine = getVal('headLine');
				  if(headLine === ""){
						headLine = headLineVal;
					}
					let pageTitleValue = getVal('pageName');
					if(pageTitleValue !== "home" || window.location.href.indexOf("hub5") != -1){
						pageTitleValue = pagetitlevalue;
					}
                    if (businessSite === false) {
                    return {
                      message: message,
                      headLine: headLine.replace(/[/"]/g, ""),
                      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl,
					  productName: getVal('productName'),
					  pageType: getVal('pageType'),
					  pageTitle: pageTitleValue,
					  productType: getVal('productType')
                    };
                  }
				  else if(businessSite === true){
                    return {
                        productName: getVal('productName'),
                        webProductName: getVal('webProductName'),
